notes: The registered C row requires level 1 at POS_SITTING, and the Go registry preserves that command-surface gate (R1/R2/R5e).
C one_argument leaves an empty amount at zero and emits the exact non-positive refusal (R1/R2/R3/R5e).
C is_number requires an all-digit first token and emits the canonical amount prompt for malformed input (R1/R2/R5e).
A parsed zero amount reaches C's exact non-positive refusal before group or gold state is inspected (R1/R3/R5e).
An amount above the actor's gold emits C's exact insufficient-gold line before distribution (R1/R3/R5e).
one_argument consumes only the first token; trailing words do not change the successful integer share (R1/R2/R3/R5e).
The grouped actor and two same-room followers receive the exact C distribution summary and recipient messages (R1/R3/R5e).
A sitting player with no AFF_GROUP reaches C's direct no-group refusal; shared group membership behavior remains owned by the group/follow vehicles (R1/R2/R5b/R5c).
